record.question: Why do some clinical trials include Phase 0 (microdosing studies)?
options: To include the study of more than one drug
To reduce the cost and time of drug development process
record.explanation: Answer B: To reduce the cost and time of drug development process. Phase 0 microdosing studies can provide early human pharmacokinetic information with limited exposure, potentially reducing time and cost before larger trials. Source/context note: Phase 0 is exploratory and does not assess efficacy or establish safety for therapeutic doses. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/exploratory-ind-study-guidance-industry. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
